tasks.name: Integration + dummy parity
tasks.note: Integration suite surfaced a real gap: useRbacStore.save only updated `matrix`, so an admin editing their OWN role row would not see the Sidebar change until re-login. Fixed the store to also refresh the caller's `map` when their role row is touched (no-op for other roles); 2 new store unit tests.

decisions.summary: RBAC matrix endpoints (GET/PUT /admin/rbac/matrix) are guarded at controller level (assertAdminOrOwner), not by `rbac:` middleware.
Admin mutation routes gated by `rbac:admin_users:read` as menu gate; controller isPlatformOwner/isAdmin is the real mutation authorization.

Generalized K-B (user-approved Option A). Spec default matrix kept 100% intact. Route mapping adjusted: (1) /ai/* drops `rbac` gate — dual-audience authorized in AIController (isAdmin()||isOutlet()); (2) POST /admin/pipeline/manual-trigger, POST /admin/measurement/events, POST|PATCH /admin/territories* gate at `read` — controllers enforce the admin write boundary; (3) POST /outlets drops `rbac` gate — self-service, finance denied in StoreOutletRequest::authorize(). Race DB seeds RbacMatrixSeeder so HTTP race workers authenticate correctly. FinanceAccessTest + RbacRouteEnforcementTest aligned.
